source.title: Process Piping - ASME Code for Pressure Piping, B31
source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads, printed folios and edition change markers are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null.

document: NOTES FOR TABLES K-1 and K-1C

general_notes.text: Notes (1) through (4) are referenced in column headings. Notes (5) through (17) are referenced in the Notes column for specific materials.
The allowable stress values given in MPa as shown in Table K-1, and given in ksi as shown in Table K-1C, may be used.

The following abbreviations are used in the Condition and Size or Thickness Range columns: ann., annealed; A.W., as worked; C.W., cold worked; H.W., hot worked; hex., hexagons; O.D., outside diameter; rd., rounds; rec., rectangles; rel., relieved; sq., squares; and str., stress.

Except as provided in para. K323.3.1(a), samples representative of metallic piping components and their welds shall be Charpy V-notch impact tested in accordance with Table K323.3.1-1. Acceptance criteria are described in para. K323.3.5.
A product analysis of the material shall be performed. See para. K323.1.5.
Material defects may be repaired by welding only in accordance with para. K323.1.6.
The following abbreviations are used in the Product Form column: ftgs., fittings; smls., seamless; and wld., welded. NOTES:

notes.text: See ASME BPVC, Section IX, Article II, QW-200.3 for a description of P-Number groupings. P-Numbers are indicated by number or by a number followed by a letter (e.g., 8, 5B, and 11A).

The stress values are allowable stresses in tension in accordance with para. K302.3.1(a). Stress values in shear and bearing are stated in para. K302.3.1(b); those in compression in para. K302.3.1(c).
The lower temperature limit for listed materials shall be in accordance with para. K323.2.2.
The upper temperature limit for listed materials shall be in accordance with para. K323.2.1.
Pipe and tubing shall be examined for longitudinal defects in accordance with Table K305.1.2-1.

The pipe grades listed below, marked as either or both grades in accordance with API Specification 5L, shall be considered as equivalents and treated as listed materials. API 5L Grade Equivalents X-Grade L-Grade B L245 X42 L290 X46 L320 X52 L360 X56 L390 X60 L415 X65 L450
